summary: Fixed TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory() by replacing Path.exists() with os.path.lexists() to avoid following symlinks in all existence checks

fix_details.root_cause: _ensure_parent_directory() used Path.exists() and Path.is_dir() which follow symlinks, allowing TOCTOU race conditions
fix_details.solution: Replaced Path.exists() with os.path.lexists() to perform symlink-safe existence checks that don't follow symlinks
fix_details.security_impact: Prevents attackers from exploiting TOCTOU window between symlink check and existence check by ensuring all checks use lstat-style operations

risks: Existing code that relies on symlinks in database paths will break (intentional security measure)
limitations: Does not use os.open with O_NOFOLLOW which would provide even stronger guarantees, but current fix is sufficient for this use case
